scope: Two further actual performed net preparations: benzothiophene O-bromobutylation and protected tetrazolyl allylic alcohol oxidation. Named structures were independently transcribed; no temperature, purity or individual yield is invented.

records.locator: Example27.4 around normalized offset233655, explicitly following27.1 at232900. Not Example2.6's isothiazole or Example27.3's three-carbon linker.
records.source_conditions: Example27.4 converts the named fluorophenyl benzothiophenol and1,4-dibromobutane, following27.1: K2CO3/acetone,45 C10 h, filtration/evaporation and excess dibromide removed in vacuo. MS378(M,1Br) is given for27.4. The2.0 g substrate/2.7 g crude mass and other quantities in27.1 belong to its para-bromophenyl analogue, not this example; no individual yield or purity inferred.
records.structural_reconciliation: Benzo[b]thiophene has para-fluorophenyl at C3 and phenolic O at C6. O-alkylation gives O-(CH2)4-Br and retains thiophene S; there is no ring N, no C2 methyl and no three-carbon linker. An independent S-first fused-ring traversal reproduces these source-named positions and the frozen complete-reaction key.

records.locator: Example108 around normalized offset438268, oxidation of the alcohol prepared immediately before it, not Example109's subsequent two-carbon homologation.

records.experimental_product_status: Named oxidation product obtained and characterized by reported melting point/elemental analysis; analytical discrepancy retained. No clean/pure-product or numerical100% isolated-yield claim.
records.structural_reconciliation: CH2OH becomes CHO while retaining the diaryl alkene, both para-F phenyl groups, tetrazole C5 substituent and N2-triphenylmethyl protection. Independent N-first tetrazole traversal places the trityl-bearing N nonadjacent to the ring carbon (N2, not N1). The identical two aryl groups do not define alkene E/Z; no stereo assignment is removed. MnO2 is an oxidation agent, not an atom-contributing organic precursor.
